My audience of 8,570+ isn't general tech. It's specialists working in AI training, data annotation and evaluation, plus the founders and recruiters hiring them.
Performance (last 90 days, LinkedIn analytics):
→ 262,800+ impressions — up 158% vs previous quarter
→ 119,700+ unique members reached (81% beyond my own network)
→ 5,082 link clicks across posts
→ 845 saves and 249 direct shares — content people keep and forward
→ Top post: 110K impressions, 6K engagements, fully organic
I publish daily on LinkedIn and weekly through AI & Data Insights — my newsletter on the human infrastructure behind AI, read by 2,675 subscribers (+519% in weekly views).

If you're hiring AI talent, launching a product for this audience, or building your employer brand in the AI workforce space — that's what I do.

posts.text:
6 months ago, a student messaged me: "I've been coding for 3 years, but I still don't understand how an AI model learns to reason."

That's not a coding problem. It's a human logic problem.
And that's exactly what AI labs are looking for right now: not more engineers, but people who can judge, structure, and argue — to teach machines how to think the way we do.

Sovrano AI AI is opening a paid, fully remote internship program built around exactly that.
No coding involved. Instead, you'll:
→ Evaluate AI-generated model outputs
→ Write structured, well-reasoned feedback
→ Help AI systems better understand human reasoning

The format:
• 100% remote
• 20 hrs/week
• 12-week program
• Paid monthly

What matters: critical thinking, rigor, and clear writing. That's it.
The people shaping the future of AI aren't all developers. They're the ones who know how to translate human reasoning into something a machine can learn from.

👉 Recommendation link in the comments.
